summary: Replaced the procedural SVG mountains/sun/fog in HeroSection.tsx with the 9 real Firewatch PNG layers (parallax0 back/sky .. parallax8 front/trees), stacked z-0..z-8 inside absolute-inset wrappers rendered object-cover and oversized ~110% via negative inset (-inset-[5%], not a scale class) so scroll+mouse parallax never expose edges. Reused the existing single-rAF native-scroll+pointer engine that owns each layer's inline translate3d; data-speed ramps back 0.0 -> front 0.55, data-depth back 2 -> front 26. parallax0 eager (LCP, fetchPriority high); rest lazy. PRADIPTA JANA identity + role cycler overlaid at z-20 with gentle data-speed=0.12/data-depth=0.6. Reduced-motion early-returns from rAF (static first frame). Removed dead .hero-sun/.hero-stars CSS and unused RidgeLayer/FogBand/Watchtower/PRNG code. No Lenis, no new ScrollTrigger pin.
notes: Screenshot at scroll=0 confirms real photo layers composite with correct depth and title legible. Source art has a baked-in FIREWATCH wordmark behind the title (part of parallax PNGs). Optional floating 3D model deferred to WS2.
